questionText: Identify the adverb in the sentence: "He is a very kind man."
explanation: In this sentence, "very" is an adverb of degree that modifies the adjective "kind" to indicate how kind the man is.

questionText: Identify the adverb in the sentence: "The horse can run fast."
explanation: "Fast" is an adverb of manner here because it describes how the horse runs, modifying the action verb "run".

questionText: Identify the adverb in the sentence: "The man walks quickly."
explanation: The word "quickly" tells us the manner in which the man walks, modifying the verb "walks" as an adverb.

questionText: Identify the adverb in the sentence: "He is very happy."
explanation: "Very" functions as an adverb of degree modifying the predicate adjective "happy" to emphasize the degree of happiness.

questionText: He was absent in the class _____ he was ill.
explanation: The conjunction "because" is used to introduce the reason or cause behind his absence from class.

questionText: Be attentive _____ you will succeed.
explanation: "And" connects an imperative clause expressing an instruction with the clause indicating its positive outcome.

questionText: Anwar is physically weak _____ Karim is healthy.
explanation: The coordinating conjunction "but" is used to show a contrast between Anwar being weak and Karim being healthy.

questionText: Take care _____ you will fall.
explanation: "Or" functions as a conjunction introducing an alternative consequence or warning if the command is not followed.

questionText: Tamim _____ I go to school together.
explanation: "And" is used to link two subjects ("Tamim" and "I") to form a compound subject.

questionText: Amit is tall, _____ his sister is short.
explanation: "But" is the correct conjunction because it highlights the contrast between Amit's height and his sister's height.

questionText: I don't know _____ she will come.
explanation: "If" is used as a conjunction introducing an indirect question to express uncertainty about whether an event will occur.

questionText: Is the news true _____ false?
explanation: "Or" connects two alternative possibilities ("true" or "false") in a question.

questionText: They are sad _____ hopeful.
explanation: "But" is used to express opposition or contrast between two different emotional states: being sad yet hopeful.

questionText: Sabina _____ Samira are two friends.
explanation: "And" joins the two proper nouns ("Sabina" and "Samira") together to complete the plural subject.

questionText: In the sentence "Honesty is the best policy.", what part of speech is the word "Honesty"?
explanation: "Honesty" is an abstract noun representing a quality or virtue, and it serves as the subject of the sentence.

questionText: In the sentence "He walks slowly.", what part of speech is the word "slowly"?
explanation: "Slowly" is an adverb of manner because it describes how the action of the verb "walks" is carried out.

questionText: In the sentence "We write with pens.", what part of speech is the word "with"?
explanation: "With" is a preposition showing the instrument or tool used to perform the action of writing.

questionText: In the sentence "He has three pens.", what part of speech is the word "three"?
explanation: "Three" is a numeral adjective specifying the quantity of the noun "pens".

questionText: In the sentence "Iron is hard.", what part of speech is the word "Iron"?
explanation: "Iron" is a material noun naming a physical substance, acting as the subject of the sentence.

questionText: In the sentence "The cow is a useful animal.", what part of speech is the word "useful"?
explanation: "Useful" is an adjective describing the quality of the noun "animal".

questionText: In the sentence "He is very poor.", what part of speech is the word "very"?
explanation: The word "very" modifies the adjective "poor" by indicating the degree or intensity, making it an adverb of degree.

questionText: In the sentence "Dhaka is a big city.", what part of speech is the word "big"?
explanation: The word "big" describes the size of the noun "city", so it functions as an adjective.

questionText: In the sentence "He is happy.", what part of speech is the word "happy"?
explanation: The word "happy" is a predicate adjective that follows the linking verb "is" and describes the subject pronoun "He".

questionText: In the sentence "I have a blue pencil.", what part of speech is the word "blue"?
explanation: The word "blue" describes the color of the noun "pencil", qualifying it as an adjective.

questionText: In the sentence "Milk is white.", what part of speech is the word "Milk"?
explanation: "Milk" is a material noun naming a substance and serves as the subject of the sentence.

questionText: In the sentence "The cat is fond of milk.", what part of speech is the word "of"?
explanation: The word "of" is a preposition connecting the adjective "fond" to its object "milk".

questionText: In the sentence "Kajol writes a letter.", what part of speech is the word "writes"?
explanation: The word "writes" indicates an action performed by the subject "Kajol", functioning as the principal verb.

questionText: In the sentence "It has brought about a revolutionary change in our life", what part of speech is the word "revolutionary"?
explanation: The word "revolutionary" modifies the noun "change" by describing its nature, so it is an adjective.

questionText: In the sentence "It has now become an essential part of modern life", what part of speech is the word "now"?
explanation: The word "now" is an adverb of time that modifies the verb phrase "has become" by indicating when the action occurred.

questionText: In the sentence "Computer is a fairly recent invention", what part of speech is the word "invention"?
explanation: Preceded by the article "a" and the adjective "recent", the word "invention" names a created object and functions as a noun.

questionText: In the sentence "He was also an efficient ruler", what part of speech is the word "ruler"?
explanation: "Ruler" is a common noun denoting a person who governs, qualified by the adjective "efficient".

questionText: In the sentence "He was an intelligent minister", what part of speech is the word "intelligent"?
explanation: The word "intelligent" expresses a quality or characteristic of the noun "minister", making it an adjective.

questionText: In the sentence "Iran is an ancient country", what part of speech is the word "ancient"?
explanation: The word "ancient" modifies the noun "country" by describing its historical age, functioning as an adjective.

questionText: In the sentence "Without a definite aim he cannot reach the pinnacle of glory in life", what part of speech is the word "definite"?
explanation: The word "definite" describes and modifies the noun "aim", indicating that it is fixed or specific, making it an adjective.

questionText: In the sentence "He is a rational being", what part of speech is the word "He"?
explanation: The word "He" is used in place of a noun to refer to a person, functioning as a personal pronoun and the subject of the clause.

questionText: In the sentence "Man is the best creation of Allah", what part of speech is the word "Man"?
explanation: The word "Man" is a noun used here in a general sense to refer to human beings or mankind as the subject of the sentence.

questionText: In the sentence "Good health is the key to success", what part of speech is the word "success"?
explanation: "Success" is an abstract noun that functions as the object of the preposition "to".

questionText: In the sentence "The land, the rivers and the forests are the sources of this beauty", what part of speech is the word "and"?
explanation: The word "and" connects elements of equal grammatical rank ("the rivers" and "the forests"), functioning as a coordinating conjunction.

questionText: In the sentence "Bangladesh is a land of natural beauty", what part of speech is the word "Bangladesh"?
explanation: "Bangladesh" is a proper noun naming a specific country and functions as the subject of the sentence.

questionText: In the sentence "Helen was a beauty", what part of speech is the word "beauty"?
explanation: Because it is preceded by the indefinite article "a", the word "beauty" is used as a countable noun meaning a beautiful person.
